summary: Split Body by a plane that a face of the body lies in: the ceiling of a groove that runs into a through hole. On truck the split first failed ('boolean Intersect: the operation failed: no result'); with the boolean's retry it then nudged each part's box off the plane on its own, so in the issue's part the cut faces ended at z = 1.5019 and 1.4981 and the slab between them was lost. Split Body takes each part as the body intersected with a box on one side of the plane, so that box's face coincides with the groove's ceiling. Geometry is the PR test's: a 40 x 20 x 2.5 plate, a through hole of radius 2.5 at (20, 10), and a groove 1.5 deep from the bottom, from the hole's centre out through the edge, 4 mm wide and 5 mm wide (as wide as the hole); the plane is z = 1.5. For each width: the plate alone (control), the part above and the part below. Volumes are closed form; the tolerance is 0.01 mm^3, since a cut face off the plane by 1.5e-5 mm moves either part's volume by more (each part meets the plane over 690 to 780 mm^2).

cases.name: plate_groove_4
cases.note: Control: the plate with the hole and a groove 4 mm wide, not split.

volume.formula: 2.5*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2) - 1.5*G, G = 4*20 - (2*sqrt(2.5^2 - 2^2) + 2.5^2*asin(2/2.5)), the groove less its part in the hole (tol: the split parts' 0.01 mm^3)

cases.name: above_groove_4
cases.note: The part above z = 1.5: the body intersected with a box whose bottom face lies in the groove's ceiling.

volume.formula: 1*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2) (tol: the part meets the plane over 780.37 mm^2, so a cut face 1.5e-5 mm off it moves the volume by more)

cases.name: below_groove_4
cases.note: The part below z = 1.5: the body intersected with a box whose top face lies in the groove's ceiling.

volume.formula: 1.5*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2 - G), G = 4*20 - (2*sqrt(2.5^2 - 2^2) + 2.5^2*asin(2/2.5)) (tol: the part meets the plane over 709.16 mm^2, so a cut face 1.5e-5 mm off it moves the volume by more)

cases.name: plate_groove_5
cases.note: Control: the plate with the hole and a groove 5 mm wide (as wide as the hole, its sides tangent to it), not split.

volume.formula: 2.5*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2) - 1.5*G, G = 5*20 - (2.5*sqrt(2.5^2 - 2.5^2) + 2.5^2*asin(2.5/2.5)), the groove less its part in the hole (tol: the split parts' 0.01 mm^3)

cases.name: above_groove_5
cases.note: The part above z = 1.5: the body intersected with a box whose bottom face lies in the groove's ceiling.

volume.formula: 1*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2) (tol: the part meets the plane over 780.37 mm^2, so a cut face 1.5e-5 mm off it moves the volume by more)

cases.name: below_groove_5
cases.note: The part below z = 1.5: the body intersected with a box whose top face lies in the groove's ceiling.

volume.formula: 1.5*(40*20 - pi*2.5^2 - G), G = 5*20 - (2.5*sqrt(2.5^2 - 2.5^2) + 2.5^2*asin(2.5/2.5)) (tol: the part meets the plane over 690.18 mm^2, so a cut face 1.5e-5 mm off it moves the volume by more)
